summary: Promoted J-16 (the briefing fits the page it is read on): after five journeys each added one recorded disclosure column, /desk's ranked table measures scrollWidth 1795px inside a clientWidth 1214px container capped by the page's own max-w-7xl, so `opposite` (J-14) and `levels` (J-15) are unreachable at ANY monitor width (iter-23 UT-07 = FAIL, P2/non-gating; UT-07-fail.png shows the cut-off after `band`); cause quantified read-only from screen-2026-07-30-bad6387963ef (100 ranked / 1 skipped, all 100 class A, distance median 3.38 bps, 15 tied at 0.00) - the five disclosure cells carry 194 of a row's 263 characters (74%), all whitespace-nowrap, per-column maxima summing to 309 chars, ~35 of them label prefixes the headers already state - and each ranked row is ~115px tall because DeskCoverageBadges' flex-wrap stacks the four badges into four lines (3 rows per 1440x900 frame, 100 rows ~11,500px). J-16 is render-only: zero backend diff, zero new value, zero new Data-Contract row, every data-testid + the stretched drill-in anchor + all 13 stored golden scripts untouched, SSOT criterion in place of the era-forbidden PnL append, [NEW]-flagged walkthrough that must finally SHOW the two columns in its own frames (closing iter-21/iter-23's RECORDED_WITH_NOTES gap). It also closes the iteration-state's own open design question and pre-empts a 13th column. No hold-out survivor exists or could (no pnl-scan.json; the PnL ledger still holds only the founding v1/default row at n=1 < 5, and this era's Non-Goals forbid strategy/dataset/champion work), so both proposals are kind=surface, robustness=speculative. VISION GAPS named: Key Capability 4 / J-04 step 2's leading `rank` column and KC-4 / Success Criterion 4's 'descriptive chips' for the class and distance cells are covered by NO journey - grep rank in app/desk/page.tsx matches only comments (16 hits, zero cells) and the source's own comment at :326 calls them chips while the DOM carries none - both now folded into J-16 (this subsumes backlog line 17 desk-briefing-rank-position-column per its own note); Vision claim 2's 'A coverage view says, per member, which timeframes have bars and how fresh they are' still has NO UI surface (GET /research/desk/coverage and GET /research/desk/universe have zero frontend callers; the /desk badges are the copy frozen into the displayed snapshot) - still backlogged as desk-live-coverage-view-on-page and deliberately not promoted, since adding a 9th section before the reflow lands would worsen the very defect J-16 fixes. Second new backlog entry, honestly NOT promoted: desk-row-close-equals-band-edge (all 15 rows at 0.00 bps have reference_close bit-identical to their band's own near edge, so the visible top of the briefing is a 15-way tie decided by band_score alone - already readable today via J-13's `band` cell, and any new cell must wait for J-16). desk-screen-rank-churn-between-recorded-screens (score 0.52) remains the runner-up: it needs a new owner + endpoint + a new page section, and 07-28/07-29/07-30 all read the same 2026-07-27 basis, so it stays backlogged behind the layout fix.
